name: Volume Fragment Shader (Direct Ray Marching)
definition: Computes volume rendering per fragment using direct ray construction from a fixed camera, ray-AABB intersection, ROI clipping, intensity normalization/gamma correction, and transfer function lookup.
summary: Volume Fragment Shader (Direct Ray Marching) renders 3D volumes in a single OpenGL fragment shader by marching rays through a volume texture, differing from parent methods by performing the entire traversal loop in the fragment stage.
